//: STD-001: a Default for the owner's repositories.
text: Follow github.com/tannergolden/standards, which differ from your defaults and win over this block: before you commit, branch, open a PR, write docs or tests, or add a dependency, read the matching file in its `docs/`, or say you could not.
why: A pointer tied to specific moments raised doc reading from 11% to 75%, where a bare link is rarely followed.
enforced_by: the standards' reusable workflows, in repositories that call them
to_add: gates in the core repositories that follow the standards by link
